source: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (definitive-period default values; corrected by (EU) 2026/1740)
note: Default embedded-emission values (tCO2e per tonne of product) keyed by CBAM good. `factor` is the good-level fallback (rest-of-world / average of the ten highest-emission-intensity exporters, per the binding methodology); optional `byCountry` provides country-specific values (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) that override the fallback for that origin. IMPORTANT: the LEGALLY BINDING values for the definitive period are those set out in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (with the Commission's companion Excel published for information), keyed by CN subheading and country. The numeric figures below are ILLUSTRATIVE, sector-representative placeholders so the calculator runs end-to-end — they are NOT the binding values. Load the real values with `npm run import-default-values` against the Commission's official spreadsheet and bump this dataset version. The methodology around them (mark-up, country-specific override, de-minimis, Annex III exemption) is implemented correctly.
